tenures.note: The card's own text frames him as returning to the promotion ("Caleb has come back to the PVW for a reason") harder and wilder than the wrestler fans previously knew — a template artifact of the card's own reuse from an earlier fed ("PVW"), not a claim about a second UPW tenure.

tenures.source: The federation's own wrestler application page (app001.html), its own Rampage broadcasts (June 2019 to January 2020), and its own Lonestar Heavyweight Title History (lonestartitlehistory.html).
tenures.note: Won the Lonestar Heavyweight Championship from Pat Gordon, Jr. in a triangle match with Alfie Button on 28 January 2020. On SCW's own broadcasts he vows to prove "I am not the same Caleb Foley that had the fans behind him night in and night out in PVW."

caption: Billed as the biggest name in 3DW, lost the promotion's first main event to newcomer Chance Holiday after interference from Christian Copeland's presence at ringside.

identity.note: One character across UPW and SCW, ruled on the evidence. SCW's own application (app001.html) carries UPW's own bio card's text in a new form: 6'1", 215, Dublin, Face, "Air Dublin" (a handspring cutter), "An Irish Blessing" (a spear into a standing moonsault), "Loyal to No-One", the Celtic-numeral tattoo reading 07/28/2008 and the scars "from all the battle he has had in PVW"; SCW bills him "Celtic Crippler" Caleb Foley, the name UPW's card puts on his tights. UPW's card narrates his PVW past ("Caleb has come back to the PVW for a reason"); SCW's own broadcasts narrate the same leg in his own voice ("I am not the same Caleb Foley that had the fans behind him night in and night out in PVW"). Neither federation's text names the other.
